    dh.hubregistry AS hub_registry_id,
    (dh.hubutilpct * 100) AS calculated_utilization_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN dh.hubutilpct < 0.3 THEN 'Underutilized'
        WHEN dh.hubutilpct >= 0.3 AND dh.hubutilpct < 0.7 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS utilization_classification
FROM 
    distributionhubs AS dh
JOIN 
    operations AS o ON dh.hubregistry = o.opshubref
ORDER BY 
    calculated_utilization_value DESC;
